eligibility: Official TIGER tract INTPT (INTPTLON, INTPTLAT) covered by the 2025 place polygon after make_valid. ALAND <= 0 ineligible. No any-intersection. No outside-place expansion.
rook: Shared linear boundary length > 1e-3 m after make_valid and EPSG:5070. Corner-only contact is not rook. No distance fallback.
seed: Official TIGER place INTPT container; else nearest eligible tract INTPT in EPSG:5070; GEOID ASC
growth: greedy_lex: PP_COMPARE DESC -> shared boundary DESC -> distance-to-seed ASC -> GEOID ASC
component_policy: Eligible < 25 -> INSUFFICIENT_ELIGIBLE_TRACTS. Seed-component < 25 -> INSUFFICIENT_CONNECTED_TRACTS (no island jump). Do not invent 25.
